Find spatially corrected ECM markers between two groups

Source: R/differential-expression.R
find_spatially_corrected_ecm_markers.Rd

Runs a two-stage workflow designed for within-sample comparisons where spatial autocorrelation matters. ECM genes are first screened with a Wilcoxon rank-sum test, then significant hits are re-tested with a spaMM spatial mixed model using Matern covariance.

Usage

find_spatially_corrected_ecm_markers(
  seurat_obj,
  group.by,
  ident.1,
  ident.2,
  assay = NULL,
  layer = "data",
  min.pct = 0.05,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25,
  wilcox.padj.threshold = 0.05,
  categories = NULL,
  sp_topfrac = 1,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

seurat_obj

A Seurat object

group.by

Metadata column defining the comparison groups

ident.1

Group of interest

ident.2

Reference group

assay

Assay to use. If NULL, auto-detects.

layer

Expression layer to test. Defaults to "data".

min.pct

Minimum fraction of spots expressing the gene in either group. Defaults to 0.05.

logfc.threshold

Minimum absolute log2 fold-change required to send a gene to the spatial model. Defaults to 0.25.

wilcox.padj.threshold

Adjusted p-value threshold for Wilcoxon pre-screening. Defaults to 0.05.

categories

Optional matrisome categories to restrict testing to.

sp_topfrac

Optional fraction of Wilcoxon-significant genes to pass to spaMM, ranked by adjusted p-value. Defaults to 1.

verbose

Print progress messages

Value

Data frame containing Wilcoxon statistics, spaMM statistics, and matrisome annotations.

Details

This function mirrors the differential expression strategy used in the MatriSpace case study: Wilcoxon pre-screening on ECM genes followed by spatial correction with spaMM::fitme(gene_expr ~ group + Matern(1 | x + y)).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
spatial_de <- find_spatially_corrected_ecm_markers(
  seurat_obj,
  group.by = "CompositionCluster_CC",
  ident.1 = "CC1",
  ident.2 = "CC3"
)
} # }
